verdict.rationale: The pack never documents linking commits or pull requests to issues, nor closing keywords in commit messages that update issue status automatically. The only nearby items are a generic issues/projects claim, an agent workflow that runs from issue to PR, and a third-party Jira sync app. None of these is GitHub's own commit-to-issue linking with status automation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link commits and pull requests to issues and have issue status update automatically from commit messages
